card_title: Artist Notes: Eau De Toilette: Solar Citrus
summary: High-velocity brightness. A highly volatile, fast-evaporating burst of hyper-realistic grapefruit and crushed green leaves.
description: Kinetic summer energy. Formulated with a higher alcohol-to-oil ratio, this EDT is designed for an explosive initial projection, offering a crisp, refreshing, and ephemeral olfactory experience.
technical_overview: Offered at $65.0 for 100ml, this KoColor EAU_DE_TOILETTE is expertly formulated with Ethanol, Cold-Pressed Grapefruit Oil, and Petitgrain. It delivers a high-fidelity Solar Gold color profile (`#FFD700`) and leverages high-velocity top-note evaporation.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Spray generously over the chest and shoulders for an immediate atmospheric shift.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Store in the refrigerator during the summer; the cold alcohol dramatically intensifies the crisp, refreshing shock of the citrus top notes.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Cold-pressing the citrus rinds preserves the fragile terpenes that are normally destroyed by steam distillation.
